quality_rules.description: Full credit when the session emits a normal completion event; partial credit for subagent-only completion.
quality_rules.name: Completion

quality_rules.description: Penalizes high token-per-tool usage and unusually large tool counts, using local distribution thresholds when available.
quality_rules.name: Efficiency

quality_rules.description: Rewards clean tool execution and scales down as failed tool calls exceed the expected local failure rate.
quality_rules.name: Tool reliability

quality_rules.description: Penalizes repeated use of the same tool in adjacent steps, which usually indicates stalled exploration or retry loops.
quality_rules.name: Loop detection

quality_rules.description: Penalizes very short sessions and long outliers when sufficient timing evidence is available.
quality_rules.name: Duration health

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that recover after failed tool calls; sessions without failures receive baseline credit.
quality_rules.name: Error recovery

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that use a reasonable mix of tools instead of a single repeated action.
quality_rules.name: Tool diversity

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that convert exploration into edits, using the edit-to-read ratio when available.
quality_rules.name: Edit productivity

quality_rules.description: Full credit when the session emits a normal completion event; partial credit for subagent-only completion.
quality_rules.name: Completion

quality_rules.description: Penalizes high token-per-tool usage and unusually large tool counts, using local distribution thresholds when available.
quality_rules.name: Efficiency

quality_rules.description: Rewards clean tool execution and scales down as failed tool calls exceed the expected local failure rate.
quality_rules.name: Tool reliability

quality_rules.description: Penalizes repeated use of the same tool in adjacent steps, which usually indicates stalled exploration or retry loops.
quality_rules.name: Loop detection

quality_rules.description: Penalizes very short sessions and long outliers when sufficient timing evidence is available.
quality_rules.name: Duration health

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that recover after failed tool calls; sessions without failures receive baseline credit.
quality_rules.name: Error recovery

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that use a reasonable mix of tools instead of a single repeated action.
quality_rules.name: Tool diversity

quality_rules.description: Rewards sessions that convert exploration into edits, using the edit-to-read ratio when available.
quality_rules.name: Edit productivity
